name: PR overview shows the seeded Why + Risk brief
description: From PR #482, stay on the default Overview tab and confirm the three brief surfaces render the SEEDED pr_brief row (server/src/db/seed.ts): the PR BRIEF banner with its `why` paragraph and risk badge, the RISK AREAS block inside the Intent card, and the Review focus list — then click a focus row and land on that file in the Files-changed tab. Exercises PrBriefCard + RiskAreas + ReviewFocus + usePrBrief → GET /pulls/:id/brief. Read-only seeded data: the flow never clicks Regenerate, because a live generation needs a model key and e2e runs without one. The brief must NOT be labelled stale — the seed writes the PR's own head_sha and points review_id at the seeded review — which is asserted by the absence of the stale marker. The risk ref asserted below (src/config.ts) is deliberately also a row in the Files-changed tab: that is the grounding gate's promise checked end to end, not just the card's rendering. Expanding a risk row to its explanation is NOT covered: that step was removed on 2026-08-14 after failing in the maintainer's hermetic run while passing every attempt to reproduce it, which is exactly what retired flow 09's expand-on-click step on 2026-08-10 — see INSIGHTS.md. The refs are visible while collapsed, so the grounding assertion below never needed the click; reveal-on-expand stays covered by RiskAreas.test.tsx. Text is matched in its RENDERED case — section labels are uppercased by CSS text-transform and agent-browser matches innerText. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
